learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Chose All of them against only good and only bad at2000 offer; locked it in.
observations.exploration: Initial3000 offer:10/10 cars,average value2000. Offer2000:5/10 cars,average1000,buyers overpay feedback. Offer1000:five cars,average1000. Home on offer slider gave500,five bad cars still offered at reservation threshold.
observations.reveal: Corrected only bad; explicitly compared initial3000/all cars with2000/good owners leave at2500 minimum. Explained average quality offered falls when price ignores quality. Stated invented two-kind model and indistinguishable cars.
observations.visual: Actual1257 ×936 dark screenshot inspected. Good cars ghosted,bad cars colored;price,count and value metrics legible with full reveal.

prediction.reason: Clear seller-composition commitment under distinct reservation values.

interaction.reason: Offer contrasts visibly change composition and average value.

payoff.reason: Connects observed selection to good-owner reservation threshold and quality drop.

clarity.reason: Threshold labels,ghosted cars and metrics clarify tested desktop state.
clarity.evidence: Actual screenshot at500 withfive bad cars.

transfer.reason: General quality-selection mechanism and assumptions but no concrete new application.
transfer.evidence: Price ignores quality drives out better cars.

accessibility.reason: One slider endpoint key insufficient audit.

surprise.reason: Committed all-sell expectation contradicted by half leaving.

visualExplanation.reason: Ghosted quality group makes adverse selection visible.

playfulness.reason: Offer presets and threshold endpoint permit reversible comparison.

practicalValue.reason: Concrete buyer price versus seller selection issue central.

depth.reason: Reservation prices and endogenous quality linked.

complexity.reason: Links posted price,seller participation and conditional average quality.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Distinguish buyer values from seller minimums and recompute composition.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Low: three offer presets and labeled slider.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: moderate: adverse selection and reservation prices.

whyCool: Offering the original average makes all good cars fade out and halves the remaining average value.
caveat: Two fixed car types with hidden quality;no signaling,warranty or alternate market tested.
missingEvidence: Below500 offer unavailable on tested slider.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
